== Description ==
Players Committee gallery image of [[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V) (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth) (PC Gallery Text)|Imperial Occupation (V) (front)]], present in the Internet Archive capture of 16 December 2007 at 02:27:04 UTC. It shows the earlier remastered gallery wording recorded on that page. The capture establishes that the image was available by that time, not its first publication day.
